name: Beidiao Qu Siyu Bumen Hou, Wo Kaishi Zhaogu Yizhi Jujue Laodong de Guodong Xiong♥
original_name: 被調去飼育部門後，我開始照顧一隻拒絕勞動的果凍熊♥
source:
You used to be one of the most promising young officers in the base. Until one day... you got reassigned to the Gummy Bear Containment & Management Department.

Your mission? Simple. — Supervise a lazy-to-the-core, ridiculously squishy gummy bear (who claims she’s a “pacifist”), and make sure she produces Star Dust, the magical substance that keeps the entire base running.

Or else? The base shuts down, and everyone’s going back to their hometowns to sell canned fish.

Her daily routine? Wake up → Eat → Nap → Roll around → Lick her paw → Nap again.

Your daily routine? Break down → Spit blood → Become the company’s official clean-up crew.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206860/Gummy_Bear_Idle_No_Job_Just_Jelly/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你曾经是基地里最有前途的年轻军官之一。直到有一天……你被调到小熊软糖收容管理部。

你的使命？简单的。— 监管一只懒惰到核心、软得可笑的软糖熊（她声称自己是“和平主义者”），并确保她生产星尘，这是维持整个基地运转的神奇物质。

不然呢？基地关闭，大家都回老家卖鱼罐头。

她的日常？起床→吃饭→小睡→打滚→舔爪子→再小睡。

你的日常生活？崩溃→吐血→成为公司正式的清洁工。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206860/Gummy_Bear_Idle_No_Job_Just_Jelly/]Steam[/url]]
